name: Exomoon example (simulated)
title: A Jupiter with a 2.2 Earth-radius moon: 12 transits
notes: Simulated: a Jupiter-size planet at 45 d with a moon of 2.2 Earth radii on a 3.7 d orbit (Rm/R★ 0.02), twelve transits at 250 ppm. The moon’s radius, period and phase are free; the plot’s Moon view shows its effects in isolation, and “Search for a moon” on the System tab (after removing it) finds it from scratch.
